svg.title: More nodes carry more privacy transactions
svg.desc: A grid of privacy rate against node count under the EIP tick, with 15 tx/s of signatures. The highest privacy rate held on every seed, with every lower rate held, rises with the network: 9 at 100, 12 at 300, 15 at 1,000, 18 at 3,000 nodes. A second grid shows one builder that aggregates everything.
svg.text: More nodes carry more privacy transactions
Share of transactions included on the worst seed (%), under the EIP's 1,000 ms tick,
with 15 tx/s of signatures plus the privacy rate on the left. Priced by leanVM 990b935's cycle counts;
a privacy witness costs one nested proof; raw transactions reach every node. 4 seeds per cell.
privacy tx/s, on top of 15 tx/s of signatures
